initial_general_construction.construction: original independent general Core backend; no selected HIA image, target compiler, or successor passed to construction
initial_general_construction.external_abi: SysV AMD64 scalar C functions plus explicit synchronous borrowed-byte pointer/length entrypoints
runtime_assumptions: Linux x86-64 LP64 runtime and ordinary C scalar ABI
calloc/malloc return null or fresh nonaliasing allocations; calloc initializes every byte
free releases a live allocation; libc memory functions implement their standard byte semantics
abort terminates execution; traps do not promise cleanup
linker, loader, libc and host hardware are trusted; native execution has no VM step/heap/call quotas
foreign caller supplies live, correctly sized allocations for the synchronous call
mutable foreign ranges are exclusive and read-only ranges are not concurrently mutated
numeric guards do not prove allocation provenance or pointer liveness

native_filter_root.construction: mechanical six-word invocation of independently seeded HIA packer on its own image

native_source_rebuild.boundary: stdlib test harness supplies exact bytes and verifies independent roots; every HIA semantic projection/emission/packing operation is an actual standalone native child with empty PATH; root production cold driver composes same ABI without Python
